items.title: AI-Native vs. Anti-AI Engineers
items.raw_excerpt: One of the key differences I an seeing between AI-native engineers and Anti-AI ones: the idea of "fully understanding" what you ship. Before LLMs, we did not fully understand the libraries we read, the kernels we touched, the networks we only grasped conceptually. We' have always been outsourcing intelligence to other engineers, teams, and systems for decades. One possible reason is that we use a library, we can tell ourselves we could read it. With an LLM, the fiction of potential understanding collapses. The real shift I am seeing isn't from "understanding" to "not understanding." It is towatds "I understand the boundaries, guarantees, and failure modes of what I'm responsible for." If agentic coding is the future, mastery becomes the ability to steer, constrain, test, and catch failures

title_i18n.en: AI-Native vs. Anti-AI Engineers
title_i18n.zh: 原生AI工程师与反AI工程师
title_i18n.es: Ingenieros Nativos de la IA versus Anti-IA

excerpt_i18n.en: One of the key differences I an seeing between AI-native engineers and Anti-AI ones: the idea of "fully understanding" what you ship. Before LLMs, we did not fully understand the libraries we read, the kernels we touched, the networks we only grasped conceptually. We' have always been outsourcing intelligence to other engineers, teams, and systems for decades. One possible reason is that we use a library, we can tell ourselves we could read it. With an LLM, the fiction of potential understanding collapses. The real shift I am seeing isn't from "understanding" to "not understanding." It is towatds "I understand the boundaries, guarantees, and failure modes of what I'm responsible for." If agentic coding is the future, mastery becomes the ability to steer, constrain, test, and catch failures
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我观察到AI原生工程师与反AI工程师之间的一个关键差异在于对“完全理解”所交付产品的理念。在大型语言模型出现之前，我们并未完全理解所阅读的库和接触的内核。
excerpt_i18n.es: Una de las diferencias clave que observo entre los ingenieros nativos de IA y los anti-IA: la idea de "entender completamente" lo que se despliega. Antes de los LLM, no entendíamos por completo las bibliotecas que leíamos ni los núcleos con los que interactuábamos.

items.title: AMD CEO Lisa Su Says Concerns About an AI Bubble Are Overblown

title_i18n.en: AMD CEO Lisa Su Says Concerns About an AI Bubble Are Overblown
title_i18n.zh: AMD首席执行官苏姿丰表示，对人工智能泡沫的担忧被夸大了。
title_i18n.es: La CEO de AMD, Lisa Su, afirma que las preocupaciones sobre una burbuja de IA son exageradas.

excerpt_i18n.es: Lisa Su lidera el mayor rival de Nvidia en el mercado de chips de IA. Cuando se le preguntó en el evento Big Interview de WIRED si la IA es una burbuja, la directora ejecutiva de la empresa afirmó: "Enfáticamente, desde mi perspectiva, no".
